working_definition: Cells of the authors' ectoderm cluster(s) (Ing-Simmons et al. 2021, Fig. 2; markers ab, sca, SoxN), control embryos at 2.5-3.5 h after egg laying.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A(n) somatic cell that is part of a(n) ectoderm.
